Its blind spots under independent review are concurrency, resource lifetimes, unchecked narrowing, deadlines bypassed by blocking writes, private input in ordinary errors, and tests that build expected values from the code under test.
It does not budget wall time: one fix lane ran 303 minutes, about four of them hours on a test of its own that deadlocked the runtime.
Seven or eight concurrent max lanes on the Go endpoint drew three 429 ttft_admission_refused refusals in an hour.
